pois.name: Tunde's room
pois.note: Opening. A single room off a shared corridor, a short walk from Ladi Lane Parts Market. No light, landlord banging for rent.

pois.name: The steal
pois.note: Opening. A food stall at the near end of Ladi Lane Parts Market, where Tunde grabs food. 'Ole!' starts here and the chase runs through the market.

pois.name: Boss's post
pois.note: Opening. A canopy over a bench at the west mouth of Ladi Lane Parts Market, where the boss's boys collect the park's levy from the traders. The boss sits here during the opening and sees the chase come out of the aisle.

pois.name: Ladi Lane Parts Market
pois.note: Maze of tokunbo car parts. Chop-shop missions.

pois.name: Press Row
pois.note: House-front presses. Forged papers at 4 a.m.

pois.name: Gang Canal
pois.note: Canal that divides two street gangs. Crossing changes who chases you.

pois.name: Gari Yard
pois.note: Wholesale rice and beans.

pois.name: Transformer 44
pois.note: When it's hit, the whole Maze goes dark (blackout event).

pois.name: Maze Central Mosque
pois.note: Green dome, two minarets. Friday 1 p.m. prayers close the streets around it.

pois.name: Gidi Teaching Hospital
pois.note: The city's biggest hospital, on the Maze's edge. Where you wake up after going down. Its road floods every rain.

pois.name: Maze Police Division
pois.note: Seized okadas go to the pound behind it. Pay to get your bike back.

pois.name: Fire of Zion Ministries
pois.note: A church in a converted warehouse. Banners outside, all-night vigils on Fridays.

pois.name: Maze Community Primary School
pois.note: Public school with a sandy yard and painted walls. School-run jams at 7 a.m. and 2 p.m.

pois.name: Victory Ministries
pois.note: Shopfront church. Plastic chairs, a keyboard, Sunday crowds on the road.
